title: Quota Whisperer
after: after Lab 9; needs 1 free container group
space: the student's private Dojo Cloud subscription (`{user}`), in their own folder `~/challenges/<id>` with its own state; resources tagged `challenge=<id>`
goal: Your code declares 5 sites but your subscription only holds 2 container groups in total. Make the apply succeed without asking for more quota.
seed: a starter `main.tf` in `~/challenges/c2` with a `for_each` over 5 names, each already prefixed with the student's username.
verify_text: `resource_state`: at least one `challenge=c2` site running, no `QuotaExceeded` in the last apply, and a `plan` in the challenge folder that is clean. The count never needs to be exact, since the free quota depends on what the student still has from the labs.
hints: The error tells you the limit.
The list feeding `for_each` is what decides how many.
